title: Dollar deluge from FCNR push to test RBI's liquidity drain toolkit
summary: RBI’s dollar mobilization drive has far exceeded expectations, drawing $136.4 billion. But the inflows have also sloshed the banking system with liquidity, leaving the central bank with a problem of plenty, and no easy way to drain it without other costs.

title: RBI curbs push prop traders to tap clients’ shares for derivatives
summary: Some traders are using wealthy investors’ idle shares as collateral for margins.

title: “Unbecoming of trustee”: Tata Trusts comment, says Vijay Singh; Tata Trusts say the charity commissioner said so.
summary: The charity commissioner's dismissal of a Tata Sons share transfer probe included sharp criticism of trustee Vijay Singh's conduct—a remark Singh attributes to the Trusts' own filing, while the organization insists it originated from the regulator.

title: Bajaj Group's Bajel Projects skips the elephant dance, opts for a steady walk
summary: Bajaj Group’s EPC firm Bajel Projects is resisting the temptation to chase rapid growth even as India’s renewable energy push lifts demand for power transmission. Instead, it is picking projects carefully, sharpening execution, expanding capacity and looking overseas for better margins.

title: High on subscriber gains, Vodafone Idea flexes its creative muscle
summary: After recording its first quarterly subscriber addition since the 2018 merger in the June quarter, Vodafone Idea is looking to bring back its creative swagger.

title: EMI affordability: When does an ‘affordable monthly payment’ become unaffordable? Experts explain
summary: A manageable EMI is about more than a low monthly payment. Experts explain the 30% EMI rule, debt risks and how borrowers can assess loan affordability while protecting savings and financial security. Seeking professional guidance is a must when faced with financial hardships.&nbsp;

title: Bank holiday today: Check if SBI, HDFC, ICICI branches are open or closed on Saturday, September 5
summary: September 5 is Teachers' Day in India, but banks remain open as it is the first Saturday of the month. RBI guidelines mandate bank closures on specific Saturdays and Sundays. Details here.
